items.gold_nlq: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?
items.gold_sql: SELECT tm.AUTHOR, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS Total_Record_Count , COUNT(distinct td.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN (select TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, CASE WHEN INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(AUTHOR, 1, INSTR(AUTHOR, ';') - 1) ELSE AUTHOR END AS AUTHOR FROM TIP_MATERIAL) tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tm.AUTHOR, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, sd.SCHOOL_NAME;

iterations.nlq: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?
iterations.generated_sql:
SELECT
  tm.AUTHOR AS author,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_counts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_course_types
FROM TIP_DETAIL td
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
  ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  tm.AUTHOR,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;

iterations.nlq: What is the author (using only the first author name when multiple authors are listed, i.e., take the text before the first semicolon), school name, and material status, along with the total record counts and the total number of distinct courses, for each combination of that author, school, and material status?

FROM TIP_DETAIL td

JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso

  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tm.AUTHOR, ';', 1)),
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS;
